# The registered "compiler" for this issue is run-link4168.cmd, not dxc.exe.
# The reported symptom is D3D12_SHADER_BUFFER_DESC::Variables on a *linked*
# shader, so reaching it needs three executables: dxc to build the library, dxl
# to link it into a shader, and dxa -dumpreflection to walk
# ID3D12ShaderReflection. The harness dispatches the leading token to that tool
# and echoes the command it runs, so this file holds the whole sequence and a
# reader can run any line by hand with the tool directory on PATH.
#
# Profiles are the reporter's own, from the 2022-01-23 comment: "compile
# modules in lib_6_x profile, and link to ps_6_0". No other flags -- the issue
# reports none.
dxc -T lib_6_x -Fo lib4168.dxo repro.hlsl
dxl -T ps_6_0 -E main -Fo linked4168.dxo lib4168.dxo
dxa -dumpreflection linked4168.dxo
